wiki.quote: Может, овцы и хотят помириться с волком, но волк всегда отвечает одно – нет.

entries.name: Axe
lines: Berserker's Call can keep Lycan in place during his Shapeshift even through Black King Bar.
Counter Helix is very effective against Lycan because of his summons.
Culling Blade will prevent Lycan from running away with Shapeshift when he drops low.

entries.name: Beastmaster
lines: Primal Roar allows Beastmaster to keep Lycan in place after he used his Shapeshift.

entries.name: Bloodseeker
lines: Rupture completely negates Lycan's high mobility.
All of Lycan's summons are good sources of healing with Bloodrage.

entries.name: Bristleback
lines: Quill Spray can be used to kill Lycan's summons.
Bristleback allows him to stay alive against Lycan while dishing out counter attacks
He can overpower Lycan with his Warpath instead.

entries.name: Earthshaker
lines: A well landed Fissure can potentially take Lycan out of the fight for several seconds, who heavily relies on precious seconds from Black king bar and Shapeshift to fight.
Aftershock reduces the effectiveness of his summons and can prove quite irritating for Lycan.
Echo Slam is very powerful with the sheer amount of Lycan's units and will cause him to think twice when pushing towers.

entries.name: Enigma
lines: Can cast Demonic Conversion on one of Lycan's Wolves, making this a numbers fight.
Malefice will greatly reduce his ability to engage
Midnight Pulse can steep an area making it harder for Lycan to engage in.

entries.name: Enchantress
lines: She can Enchant one of the wolves to her side.
Lycan will struggle greatly to harm Enchantress through her Untouchable which can seriously slow down Lycan's attack speed even if Lycan is spell immune.

entries.name: Grimstroke
lines: Stroke of Fate deals more damage when it hits more targets which makes it very effective in dealing with Lycan and his units.
Soulbind prevents Lycan from running away and makes him very easy to deal with.

entries.name: Kunkka
lines: Tidebringer can be used to kill Lycan's summons.
Can also build into Heaven's Halberd which will disable Lycan's auto attacks, crippling him even more.

entries.name: Medusa
lines: Her Mana Shield is too tough for Lycan to break.
Mystic Snake can hit for a massive damage once it spread between his summons.

entries.name: Omniknight
lines: Guardian Angel completely negates all of Lycan's damage since Lycan mainly deals physical damage.
Purification can also be a problem for Lycan, as Purification deals damage around the target, which poses a problem for him and his summons.

entries.name: Phantom Assassin
lines: Phantom Assassin's Blur is a real problem for Lycan, as he relies entirely on direct attacks to deal damage.

entries.name: Spirit Breaker
lines: Charge of Darkness allows Spirit Breaker to catch up to Lycan after he uses Shapeshift.

entries.name: Sven
lines: Great Cleave will kill Lycan's summons very rapidly.
Warcry will allow Sven and his allies to tank Lycan's damage, which is mainly physical.
Storm Hammer will damage and stun Lycan's as well as his summons.

entries.name: Tidehunter
lines: Kraken Shell grants him massive physical attack protection
Anchor Smash will wipe the area, clearing Lycan's wolves.

entries.name: Timbersaw
lines: All of Timbersaw's spells deal AoE damage, killing Lycan's summons very quickly.
Reactive Armor will gain stacks quickly because of Lycan's summons.

entries.name: Winter Wyvern
lines: Arctic Burn allows Winter Wyvern to escape Lycan, even when he uses his ultimate.
Splinter Blast is very effective in dealing with Lycan's summons.
Cold Embrace saves allies from Lycan's raw physical damage and can buy allies enough time to turn the tide of battle.
Winter's Curse stops Lycan in his tracks and is very effective because of his summons.

Treant Protector grants protection against his attacks with Living Armor and his ultimate, Overgrowth is a massive AoE disarm and root that pierces spell immunity, causing trouble to Lycan. You will find yourself in need of an ally's dispel or forced to pop Black King Bar for its dispel.
Fairy Knight's insanely high armor and splash damage can cause Lycan to struggle taking him down.
Keeper of the Light has a blind, which causes Lycan to miss his attacks.
Pugna's Decrepify prevents the target from taking physical damage or doing damage, which poses a huge problem for Lycan, as he mainly deals physical damage.
Faceless Void can lock Lycan down with his Chronosphere pinning him down as long as his ultimate is up.

Town Portal Scroll is rather efficient against Lycan, as he lacks disables to stop a teleporting Hero from escaping. And if he is split-pushing a lane, this might make him turn around. If not, stay alert as he might dive.
Heaven's Halberd is a good counter to attacks, on which Lycan heavily relies.
Blade Mail's return damage might cause Lycan to stop attacking his victim. If not, Lycan will take loads of returned damage.

Ghost Scepter and Ethereal Blade prevents the user from taking physical damage from Lycan as Lycan is mainly a physical damage dealer while also making Lycan more vulnerable to magical damage. However, Lycan can easily counter this problem by purchasing Nullifier, which will give him more attack damage and a dispel to remove the ethereal buff on the hero who tries to use it to protect himself against Lycan and Black King Bar to remove the ethereal debuff from himself.

Rod of Atos limits Lycan's mobility during his ultimate. Later it can be upgraded into Gleipnir that can limit mobility of both, Lycan and his wolves while also passively providing a chance to release a chain lightning that can bounce on Lycan and his wolves. However, Lycan can counter this with Black King Bar, a common item on Lycan.
Crimson Guard reduces the damage taken from Lycan's units and drastically improves how long a tower survives his push.

entries.name: Lich
lines: Lich possesses a lot of slows, which Lycan doesn't care about when he Shapeshifts.
Lich has no in-built escape, which makes him a good target for Lycan.

entries.name: Techies
lines: He can send wolves to defuse Proximity Mines, and he can catch up Techies and kill him before they can deny themselves. Even if the suicide is successful, Lycan can still survive because of his tankiness.

entries.name: Arc Warden
lines: Magnetic Field is useless against melee heroes, so Lycan can attack Arc Warden without missing.
Flux doesn't affect Lycan that much, because Shapeshift grants immunity to slows and because he is never alone.
If their File:ArcWardenUltPng.jpeg Tempest Double has been called, Lycan can still kill Arc Warden before the double expires.

entries.name: Drow Ranger
lines: The Wolves's speed causes the knockback from Gust to be ineffective.
Drow Ranger lacks escapes and loses her Marksmanship when someone is near her. Lycan can take advantage of these weaknesses of Drow Ranger.

entries.name: Ursa
lines: Lycan's ultimate makes him immune to slows from Ursa's Earthshock as well as allowing him to outmaneuver Ursa during Enrage. Lycan can also easily chase down Ursa while shapeshifted, should Ursa try to flee.
Heroes with single-target abilities will be overwhelmed by Lycan and his summons: Wraith King, Bane, Phantom Assassin.
You can easily kill a squishy Sniper, due to your high movement speed and his lack of escape.
Once you get a Black King Bar, squishy spellcasters like Thor, Skywrath Mage and others will be probably easy to deal with.
Heroes with low armor and little mobility, like Huskar, Io, etc. will also have an unfortunate fate.

entries.name: Beastmaster
lines: His Inner Beast also work on Lycan's own minions.

entries.name: Chen
lines: Creeps enchanted with Holy Persuasion benefit from Howl.
Plenty of those creeps provide auras that strengthen Lycan and his minions.
Lycan is a notable solo-pusher. If he over-stayed his welcome in the enemy's base, perhaps he can be kept alive with Hand of God.

entries.name: Nature's Prophet
lines: Nature's Prophet is (like Lycan) a jungling and laning hero, so his absence while fighting Roshan is not a great concern for his teammates. Finally, the Prophet's ability to teleport directly into Roshan's pit is also useful for avoiding enemy wards (using Nature's Call in Roshan's Pit with Sprout is advised, however, in order to remain undetected by said wards).
Perhaps your allies don't have any summons, but maybe they'll bring one in through purchase of a Helm of the Dominator. You might as well do it.
Heroes that can reduce the armor of enemies can greatly increase Lycan's damage, such as Slardar's Corrosive Haze.

entries.name: Tango
lines: Tango sustains health in lane.

entries.name: Healing Salve
lines: Healing Salve restores good amount of health in the early game.

entries.name: Iron Branch
lines: Iron Branch gives attributes for cheap; use with Tango to get more heal.

entries.name: Quelling Blade
lines: Quelling Blade helps Lycan with getting last hits.

entries.name: Boots of Speed
lines: Boots of Speed give a basic movement speed bonus.

entries.name: Blight Stone
lines: Blight Stone will improve wolves' damage output by reducing targets' armor. It can build into Medallion of Courage or Desolator.

entries.name: Power Treads
lines: Power Treads gives you movement speed, attack speed, and ability to switch to suitable attributes.

entries.name: Helm of the Dominator
lines: Helm of the Dominator controls a neutral creep, which will also benefit from Lycan's abilities.

entries.name: Assault Cuirass
lines: Assault Cuirass gives armor and attack speed to Lycan and his allies (including his summons), and reduces the opponents' armor (including their towers').

entries.name: Desolator
lines: Desolator improves Lycan's tower pushing and increases his damage. It also synergizes with an Assault Cuirass pickup and creates a huge armor disparity.

entries.name: Black King Bar
lines: Black King Bar gives more strength and temporary spell immunity so Lycan can shred his targets without worrying about disables.

entries.name: Smoke of Deceit
lines: Smoke of Deceit lets Lycan and teammates slip into Roshan's pit unnoticed by the enemies.

entries.name: Armlet of Mordiggian
lines: Armlet of Mordiggian boosts the damage output of strength heroes efficiently with bonus attack speed, attack damage, and strength. It also increases survivability with health regeneration, armor, and toggling of Unholy Strength to create more health.

entries.name: Mask of Madness
lines: Mask of Madness greatly increases attack speed to farm creeps and heroes.

entries.name: Vladmir's Offering
lines: Vladmir's Offering gives lifesteal, damage, and armor in an aura, so his wolves get more powerful as well. The mana regeneration also helps with his small mana pool.

entries.name: Helm of the Dominator
lines: Helm of the Dominator provides the ability to control a neutral creep that comes with its own abilities and auras, and which can benefit from the bonus attack damage of Feral Impulse.

entries.name: Helm of the Overlord
lines: Helm of the Overlord allows Lycan to take control of an ancient creep which can benefit from Feral Impulse and Shapeshift. However, the ancient creep will give away 250 gold on death.

entries.name: Echo Sabre
lines: Echo Sabre applies double attacks and movement speed slow, easing ganking.

entries.name: Nullifier
lines: Nullifier will give Lycan great attack damage and a dispel to use against heroes who try to protect themselves against Lycan with becoming ethereal.

entries.name: Heaven's Halberd
lines: Heaven's Halberd boosts Lycan's survivability with strength, status resistance, and evasion. The bonus attack damage and disarm also helps him fight enemy heroes better.

entries.name: Boots of Travel
lines: Boots of Travel gives superb navigation in the late game, allowing Lycan to teleport to and push down lanes or join allies in ganks. You can target any friendly creeps, including your wolves.

entries.name: Monkey King Bar
lines: Monkey King Bar gives Lycan's attacks true strike, allowing him to fight back against heroes who rely on evasion, making this item good in combination with Shapeshift.

entries.name: Bloodthorn
lines: Bloodthorn can give Lycan silence to use to disable enemy heroes while making them more vulnerable and causing Lycan's attacks and attacks from his wolves to deal critical damage and to have true strike on the affected target.

entries.name: Abyssal Blade
lines: Abyssal Blade provides a reliable stun and random bashes to lockdown a target, ameliorating Lycan's lacks of disables.

entries.name: Scythe of Vyse
lines: Scythe of Vyse provides a ranged disable for Lycan, helping him lock down heroes with an escape.

entries.name: Heart of Tarrasque
lines: Heart of Tarrasque greatly increases health and health regeneration allowing Lycan to tank more effectively. The damage gained from it is also entirely based on strength, which is amplified by Lycan being a strength hero and by Feral Impulse. Lycan can also run out of a fight with Shapeshift at very low HP and come right back into it after a short rest.

entries.name: Aghanim's Scepter
lines: Aghanim's Scepter gives Lycan the Wolf Bite ability, with which he can boost an allied hero with Shapeshift properties, giving them hasted movespeed, 400 HP, immunity to slows, a 40% chance to deal a critical strike dealing 150% damage, and lifesteal as long as Lycan is within a 1200 radius. Bear in mind, however, that the affected hero will have melee attack range.

entries.name: Aghanim's Shard
lines: Aghanim's Shard allows Lycan to passively summon one uncontrollable wolf that moves with the normal creep wave. Additionally, wolves spawned this way may Cripple towers, which can greatly boost Lycan's pushing potency.

playstyle.text: Lycan — агрессивный оборотень, герой основы, обычно выбираемый на сложную линию. Его способности делают его одним из сильнейших героев ранней игры, способным за считанные секунды расправляться с противниками и их постройками. Способность Summon Wolves призывает двух (с талантом — четырёх) волков, которые будут сражаться на стороне героя. Волки не наносят огромного урона, но, начиная со второго уровня способности, они имеют невидимость, а с третьего — могут покалечить противника, замедляя его скорость атаки и нанося периодический урон. Волки имеют также неплохой урон по постройкам, что расширяет их стратегические возможности. При использовании способности Howl Lycan и его волки издают пугающий вой, из-за которого у врагов вокруг снижаются урон и броня. Пассивная способность Feral Impulse даёт герою и подконтрольным его существам (волкам и подчиненным Helm of the Dominator крипам) бонус к урону и восстановлению здоровья, благодаря чему герой может реализовывать лесных крипов лучше других призывателей. Ультимативная способность Shapeshift превращает героя в свирепого волка, который перемещается с увеличенной скоростью и наносит увеличенный критический урон. Своевременно используя способности, Lycan становится неуловимым, осаждая башни и постепенно загоняя врагов на их базу.

lines: Lycan will most commonly be played in the safelane. With a starting point in Feral Impulse or Howl for bonus attack speed to last hit with, especially if you add a Quelling Blade on top of that. Early levels in Summon Wolves is not as good since they do not deal enough damage and cost too much mana. Once you have acquired Power Treads and Mask of Madness or Armlet of Mordiggian, you should take down the enemy tower of your lane. Then you can rotate to push other towers with your teammates if they managed well in the laning stage. Otherwise, you can farm the jungle instead and give your lane to the supports so they can catch up in gold and experience. After taking a few outer towers to gain map control, you should think about killing Roshan with Blight Stone or its upgrades; be sure to ask your team to help and go in with Smoke of Deceit. From then on, you will either want something to take down towers even quicker (Desolator and Assault Cuirass) or to start properly fighting your enemies (Skull Basher and Black King Bar). In the mid and late game, you will have enough mana to Summon Wolves and have them scout and follow enemy heroes, giving your team vision to safely push and gank.

Choose to max Howl out before the final point in Feral Impulse on the generic build (Feral Impulse scales linearly whereas extra points in Howl also comes with cooldown reduction). If your team has a couple of summons and auras of its own (Chen and Beastmaster for the obvious examples), and the opposition lacks methods to clear creep waves and summons, you can force all outer towers very early in the game. With the map-control advantage, you should be able to take down Roshan and possibly push for high ground and/or the throne before the twenty-minute mark.

Since Lycan will still require a decent amount of experience to be effective, you may consider putting him in the mid lane to get his levels. As mentioned previously, his huge base damage should allow him to get his last hits (you can even use Howl to secure them further) and perhaps some denies, and he can possibly harass the enemy mid laner with his wolves.

In this scenario, you'll still want to rush Vladmir's Offering except if someone else on your team is better suited for it. You probably won't want to skip Power Treads since you'll want to finish the game as soon as possible so you'll need mid game items. You can get an Armlet of Mordiggian or a Crimson Guard to tank some tower shots at little cost.
The attack damage and health talents affect the regular Lycan Wolves and the Lane Wolves.

When taking on Roshan, it is advised to use a Smoke of Deceit to avoid being spotted by enemy observer wards. Teams facing a Lycan will do their best to prevent early Roshan kills by planting observer wards near the pit; given that a detected Lycan is easy prey while doing battle with Roshan, slipping past those wards will do wonders for his lifespan.

At level 7, with items like Mask of Madness and Power Treads or Medallion of Courage, Lycan can solo Roshan. Summon Wolves and tank them alternately with the hero, but do not let them die until the re-summon is ready. Keep Shapeshift just in case the enemy comes for you, so you can escape.
Any item that provides armor reduction (Desolator, Medallion, Assault Cuirass) or an aura benefits the wolves. Adding reduced armor to the mix will considerably increase your total DPS.
When jungling, be sure to try and keep your wolves alive as long as possible, do not use them to tank damage unless their timer is low.
There are plenty of reasons to not go to the jungle:
Try to make rotation for ganks or Roshan kills at nights when Lycan's abilities prevail and enemy vision around the map dwindles.
Wolves can be used to scout runes at the beginning of the match and during the laning phase to avoid losing gold and experience.

Always Summon Wolves in the base when going out to jungle for the first time (at about the 0-10 second mark) since the wolves are fast enough that you can get a creep camp killed without using any mana.

Wolves' invisibility at level 4, very low base attack time and quick movement make them great deniers. Use them to destroy runes, aegis, and allied towers with all impunity if the situation is too risky, or too far away for you to go there in person. The most talented players will even manage to entirely body-block a hero in a narrow path with both wolves, and possibly deny yourself if certain debuffs are placed on Lycan.

Wolves can also be used to scout and keep tabs on particular heroes without them knowing. Select your wolf and hit M (default) and then click an enemy hero; the wolf will follow the hero but will not attack, so it will remain invisible. Do this with each wolf and you can get constant vision of two enemy heroes. This is great for setting up ganks or for evaluating whether to take a team fight in a particular area. Keep in mind that if your wolves lose vision of who they are following for too long, they stop following.
You can also use the wolves' invisibility to sneak past the enemy lines and teleport to them using Boots of Travel, hitting one tier 3 while allied creeps disabled Backdoor Protection on another.
Use your wolves to stack two camps at once.
Use wolves to grab last hits in lane while you attack the neutrals; this is useful when enemies are missing or you want to accelerate farm.

Use Howl before going for kills as it will make your enemies more susceptible to physical damage and also not allow them to strike Lycan or his summons back due to the attack damage reduction it provides.
Use Howl when killing Roshan as the attack damage and armor reduction will also work on him.
Because Howl's cast point immobilizes Lycan, use it just before Shapeshift.
As the description says, the aura is applied to every unit under Lycan's control. This includes his wolves obviously and any unit he might have under control through Helm of the Dominator.
Invest in Feral Impulse during the laning stage to resist enemy harassment with health regeneration and score last hits with attack damage bonus.
Health regeneration of Feral Impulse may offset some HP removal of Armlet of Mordiggian.

Take advantage of Feral Impulse's attack damage bonus to select items and talents that provide strength or attributes to amplify damage gain, as items that give raw attack damage do not benefit from this boost.

Shapeshift is a very strong and versatile ultimate to use. When activated, it gives Lycan hasted movement speed, allowing a great deal of maneuverability in battle to chase down fleeing heroes or to escape from potentially dangerous areas. While Shapeshifted, you are immune to every kind of slow, including hexes and powerful slowing ultimates like Epicenter or Freezing Field.

Up to a certain extent, once you start relying on your fast movement speed, you are more vulnerable to root effects like Pit of Malice or Frostbite, especially since Lycan seldom builds a Manta Style.

Shapeshift is an aura and the 650 movement speed is shared with units under his control allowing the wolves to chase as well. Unlike Feral Impulse, the aura is global; if you're desperate to get a bit of damage on a building (to finish it off?) you can always use Shapeshift and only send your summons in.

Go farm and keep quiet when Shapeshift is down as Lycan is vulnerable and weak during this period. You cannot gank or escape without its speed. Though, you can try to push down lanes and back off early if you feel unsafe.

Select talents that lowers cooldown and increase Shapeshift's duration to increase its uptime. In the late game, you can even store boots in your backpack for a better sixth item since Shapeshift has taken care of any mobility needs. Of course, you will need to swap boots back when Shapeshift is cooling down again, but Lycan would spend more time as wolf than as human.

talents.text: Талант 10 уровня: бонус к урону волков увеличен с 10 до 14
Талант 15 уровня: бонус к здоровью волков увеличен с 350 до 375

notes.text: Перезарядка уменьшена со 110/100/90 до 105/95/85 секунд
Дополнительный урон нейтральным крипам изменён с 2% за уровень на 18% + 2% за уровень
Изменено улучшение от Aghanim's Shard

Увеличивает число волков на 1. Они получают активную способность Hightail, которая даёт 100% уклонения, +20 к скорости атаки, максимальную скорость передвижения и возможность проходить сквозь других существ. Длительность: 6 секунд.
Теперь также даёт подконтрольным существам бонусы к скорости передвижения и шансу критической атаки

notes.text: Бонус к здоровью уменьшен с 250/350/450 до 225/325/425
Теперь можно применять на союзных крипов-героев

bio:
Бэйнхаллоу с рождения принадлежал благородному дому Эмбри, могущественнейшему из всех землевладельческих родов королевства Слом. Ещё до того, как свершилось Падение, дом Эмбри первым восстал против ненасытного короля, чьи желания становились всё страннее и страннее, а двор его заполонили колдуны и шарлатаны. Не желая больше платить вассальские залоги, Эмбри послали в столицу шеститысячную армию, но её перерезали в сражении, названным позже «Бойней отступников». Тогда старое выражение показало свою настоящую шкуру: когда метишь в шею королю, лучше рубить сразу всю голову.

Разъярённый свершившимся предательством, король истребил всякого живущего Эмбри, оставив жизнь лишь лорду и его младшему сыну, Бэйнхаллоу. Опозоренный лорд был прикован к узорчатому мраморному полу королевской залы, и монарх приказал своим волшебникам превратить мальчика в волка, чтобы тот разодрал глотку своему же отцу. «Сделайте это, — сказал король, — чтобы Лорд Эмбри осознал, как остры зубы предательства». Были призваны сильнейшие магические силы, и тело ребёнка исказилось. Однако в то время как тело Бэйнхаллоу больше не было человеческим, его душа осталась на месте — и вместо того, чтобы разодрать шею беззащитного отца, он набросился на прислугу монарха. Прежде чем волка наконец-то смогли выгнать из замка, далеко в ночь, он разорвал на клочки дюжину королевских рыцарей. Лорд Эмбри, всё ещё в кандалах, смеялся, даже когда его тело пронзил королевский меч. Теперь же Бэйнхаллоу — наследник потерянного дома Эмбри, бродящий по миру под именем Lycan. Наполовину воин, наполовину волк, он ищет возмездия за всё то, что потерял.
trivia: Фраза «Was I a wolf who dreamed he was a man?» (Был ли Я волком, которому снилось, что он человек?) отсылается к цитате Китайского философа Чжуан-цзи — «Теперь Я даже и не знаю был ли Я человеком, которому снилось, что он бабочка, или же Я теперь бабочка, которой снится, что она человек?.»
Фраза «Are you an air wolf?», отсылка к известному Американскому телесериалу «Воздушный Волк».
Фраза «Who fears the wolf should fear the forest.» является отсылкой к цитате из книги Российского писателя Фёдора Михайловича Достоевского 'Игрок' : 'Волков бояться — в лес не ходить'
При атаке под способностью Shapeshift Ликан иногда произносит: «The wolf is at your door», что является отсылкой к песне «Radiohead — A Wolf at the Door».

notes.text: Использование этого заклинания заменит уже существующих волков на новых.
Волки призываются в 200 единицах от Lycan, расстояние между ними составляет 120 единиц. Lycan считается за центр расположения.
Волки получают Invisibility на 3-ем уровне и Cripple - на 4-ом.
Уже призванные волки не усилятся c новым уровнем способности. Существа получат обновленные характеристики только после перепризыва.
В форме Shapeshift остаточная анимация равна 0,6.

notes: Применение этой способности заменит уже существующих волков на новых.
abilities.lore: То самое заклинание, что исказило его сущность, также позволяет призывать волков-напарников.
abilities.description: Призывает 2 волков, которые будут помогать герою в бою. С третьего уровня волки обладают постоянной невидимостью, а с четвёртого — имеют шанс в 20% покалечить противника атакой, отчего он получает 8 урона в секунду и теряет 60 скорости атаки на 4 секунды.
abilities.name: Summon Wolves
abilities.shard: Увеличивает число волков. Они получают активную способность Hightail, которая даёт уклонение и возможность проходить сквозь других существ, а также ускоряет передвижение и атаку.

notes.text: Дебафф не складывается сам с собой, поэтому враг, попавший под действие двух источников, получает только один дебафф.
Lycan и волки применяют эффект одновременно.
Снижение урона от атак действует только на базовый урон и урон, даваемый основным атрибутом существ. Дополнительный урон не снижается.
Ночью действует на всю карту.

abilities.lore: Леденящий кровь вой даёт врагам знать: Бэйнхаллоу уже среди них.
abilities.description: Нагоняет ужас в радиусе 2000 от владельца способности и его волков, уменьшая врагам броню и урон от атак. Ночью уменьшение брони и урона действует по всей карте.
abilities.name: Howl

notes.text: Увеличивает только базовый урон и урон, даваемый основным атрибутом существ. Дополнительный урон не увеличивается.
Действует на всех подконтрольных существ, а не только на самого героя и его волков.
Восстанавливает до 60/180/300/420 здоровья за минуту.
Бафф ауры задерживается на 0,5 сек.
Иллюзии Lycan, прирученные с помощью Enchant, не дают бонусов Enchantress и ее подконтрольным существам; сама же иллюзия бонус сохраняет.
Но в то же время иллюзии Lycan, созданные другими заклинаниями (Disruption, Wall of Replica, Reflection) дают баффы своим создателям и их существам.

abilities.lore: Звериный симбиоз с волчьим родом даёт Бэйнхаллоу улучшенные рефлексы и способности для охоты.
abilities.description: Увеличивает урон и восстановление здоровья у героя и всех подконтрольных ему существ.
abilities.name: Feral Impulse

notes.text: Требует Aghanim's Scepter для разблокировки.
В режиме Ability Draft Wolf Bite может быть разблокирована игроком, выбравшим Shapeshift.
Применяет к союзнику все эффекты Shapeshift, включая время трансформации, ночной обзор, критический удар и скорость.
Также дает ауру скорости, то есть все существа, принадлежащие укушенной цели, получают такие же бонусы, что и существа Lycan.
Но при этом вампиризм делится только между заклинателем и укушенным. Существа его не получают.
Дает обычный и общий вампиризм заклинателю и укушенному союзнику.
То есть кто бы из них не атаковал, лечение всегда получают оба.
Усиление вампиризма так же влияет на общий вампиризм, но только если владелец усиления — излечиваемое существо.
Вампиризм дается сразу при применении и для него не нужно завершение трансформации.
Для общего вампиризма заклинатель и цель должны находится на расстоянии 1200 друг от друга. Обычный вампиризм действует независимо от расстояния.
Если Shapeshift не изучена, то союзная цель потратит время на трансформацию, но не превратится.
То есть способность просто оглушает союзника и дает как ему, так и заклинателю вампиризм на 1,1 секунды.
С изученным талантом 20-го уровня на длительность Shapeshift союзник трансформируется на 6 секунд, получая вампиризм, но не скорость, ночной обзор или критический удар.

notes: Имеет такую же перезарядку, как способность Shapeshift.
abilities.description: Владелец кусает союзного героя или крипа-героя, наделяя его бонусами от способности Shapeshift. Они с целью получают 40% вампиризма, который восстанавливает здоровье им обоим, если они находятся на расстоянии не более 1200.
abilities.name: Wolf Bite

abilities.description: Повышает урон, который герой и подконтрольные ему существа наносят нейтральным крипам.
abilities.name: Apex Predator

notes.text: Во время трансформации герой не может ничего делать. Прервать трансформацию нельзя.
Увеличивает ночной обзор Lycan до 1800.
Превращает заклинателя в существо ближнего боя на всю длительность (важно для Wolf Bite и режима Ability Draft).
Скорость передвижения и критический удар предоставлены глобальной аурой, которая действует на всех подконтрольных Lycan существ. Эффект ауры задерживается на 0,1 сек.
Увеличение скорости передвижения — это ускорение, поэтому затронутых существ нельзя замедлить ниже установленного способностью значения.
В среднем критическая атака увеличивает урон героя и всех подконтрольных существ на 24%/36%/48%.
Шансы срабатывания от нескольких источников критического удара сочетаются.
Если одновременно срабатывают два источника, то приоритет будет у большего модификатора.
Критическая атака использует псевдослучайное распределение.
Shapeshift отменяется при смерти.

notes: Hex не влияет на скорость передвижения вашего героя.
abilities.lore: Навеки раб своей ликантропии, Бэйнхаллоу смирился с проклятием и принял свою свирепость как данное.
abilities.description: Герой принимает волчий облик, отчего передвигается с увеличенной скоростью, не может быть замедлен, получает увеличенный обзор ночью и шанс совершить критическую атаку. Все подконтрольные герою существа также получают бонусы к скорости и шансу крита от этой способности.
abilities.name: Shapeshift

hype: Lycan разрывает врагов острыми когтями и смертоносными клыками в обличье человека или волка. Он призывает невидимых волков, которые помогают в разведке и нападении. Превратившись в волка, он становится сильнее и быстрее и с лёгкостью догоняет врагов или спасается из засады.
name: Lycan

talents.left: +25% к доп. урону от Feral Impulse
–25% базового интервала атаки у волков от Summon Wolves
talents.right: Howl уменьшает общий урон от атак
